specNotes: EXADS documents native.plcmttype=500 for push notifications; it is a vendor extension rather than an IAB standard placement enum.
The request fixes the icon at 192x192; response image and embedded fixture match those dimensions.
Response ext.btype=1 means CPM; floor and price use CPM consistently. No CPC-to-CPM inference is necessary.
Desired capability: show actual title and all supplied image assets after fixture interception; not a claim of current product support.
Preserve the documented carrier to measure unsupported vendor shapes. Existing product acceptance is not the validity oracle.
All assets must load from the embedded fixture route; block tracking and destination navigation.

Core/HTTP assert the Native carrier asset contract. EXADS plcmttype 500 is a vendor-defined push placement signal, but automatic push tagging is not asserted by this case; it is a bounded classification coverage gap, not an invented IAB rule.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.
